name: Magazines
blurb: Every magazine spawn point in Fallout 76 — 717 placed points across 281 map markers. Pick a region for its full spawn list, or read on for the boxes, vendors and events that hand magazines over. Each issue grants a timed perk when read (no food-consumption breakdown).

world_spawns.note: Each placed point rolls the LPI_Loot_Magazines list. Which magazine issue you get is an even roll across the live pool.
